name: Massa Lubrense
description: Panoramic coastal town with a rich agricultural and culinary tradition, famous for its views of Capri.

name: Sorrento
description: The main hub of the peninsula, famous for its historic center, lemons, and high-end tourism.

name: Sant'Agnello
description: A charming residential town offering some of the best sunset views and high-quality local pizzerias.

name: Piano di Sorrento
description: A vibrant local town with a strong commercial soul and authentic, less-touristic dining options.

name: Meta
description: Known for its long beaches and family-run restaurants that preserve the traditional flavors of the area.

name: Vico Equense
description: The northern gateway to the peninsula, birthplace of the 'Pizza a Metro' and home to dramatic cliffside vistas.
